objective: Measure calibration of independently timestamped, source-qualified forward CE/PE event probabilities without admitting retrospective selections.
cohort_rule: One strategy_id, strategy_version and event_type per report; mixing is rejected.
chronology: issued_at <= independently verified published_at <= cutoff_at < following_open_at <= outcome_observed_at <= report as_of
required_prediction_provenance: exact symbol expiry strike CE/PE identity
official session calendar SHA-256 and verified-session flag
required_outcome_provenance: outcome observation timestamp no earlier than following opening
metrics: directional accuracy with Wilson 95 percent interval
Brier score and skill versus a fixed 0.5 probability
fixed ten-bin expected calibration error and reliability table
mean median and 3x 10x 20x 30x historical outcome distribution
